The Philosophy of Inpinity

More than just an NFT. A mathematical masterpiece, a philosophical manifesto, and a treasure hunt for perfect harmony.

1

The Monad & The 1

Inspired by the Pythagoreans, the number 1 represents the Monad – the origin from which everything emerges. You cannot divide 1 without getting two halves; in dividing, connection is created, not loss.

Therefore, our journey of harmony (Phi) does not begin with the leading 1, but directly with 6, 1, 8.... The 1 is omnipresent – it is the invisible foundation that encompasses the entire pyramid.

π

The Circle & Nature

Pi (3.14159...) is the infinite expanse, the circle, that which always completes itself. Phi (1.61803...) is the natural order, the measure that works in everything – from the arrangement of leaves to the structure of human existence.

At the peak of the pyramid (Block 0), the 3 (Pi) and the 6 (Phi) meet. Two concepts sharing a space before the journey into the depths begins.

φ

The Mirror & Rarity

The 0-axis forms the symmetrical heart of the pyramid. When the exact same number (Pi or Phi) is on the left side at the same distance from the center as on the right side, a mathematical mirror is created.

These blocks are not random rarities. They are proof of the universe's symmetry in numbers. Finding these mirrors is the core of the game.

The Key to Layer 2

Every block that exhibits a mirror (match) is considered Layer 1. These mathematically rare blocks are not just collectibles. They act as the key to Layer 2 – a previously introduced, animated universe that builds upon these harmonious structures.
